# Vanilla web development

Use this workflow for static websites and projects without a framework.

1. Inspect the page structure, existing CSS and JavaScript, assets, and project instructions before editing. Identify how navigation and interactive behavior currently work.
2. Implement the smallest complete change using the existing stack and patterns. Preserve working routes, content, and visual conventions.
3. Check semantic markup, keyboard interaction, focus visibility, mobile layouts, and reduced-motion preferences for any affected UI.
4. Avoid adding dependencies or build tooling unless requested or necessary. Treat external and user-provided content as untrusted when rendering it.
5. Run the project's available checks. If it has no automated checks, open the page in a browser at relevant viewport sizes and report exactly what was verified.
